jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Elmore-Morristown Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Lamoille South Supervisory Union (member towns Elmore and Morristown).

sources.note: Elmore-Morristown UUSD board page (Lamoille South SU, official): five directors -- David Bickford (Chair, Morristown resident, term expires 2028), Ann Marie Dryden (Elmore, 2028), David McAllister (Clerk, Morristown, 2027), Richard Shanley (Morristown, 2029), Peggy Sprague (Elmore-or-Morristown seat, 2027). The board sits at five since the voters' 2023 expansion from four (the seat Sprague won March 5, 2024). All seats are elected DISTRICT-WIDE (modified at-large, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2)) -- proven arithmetically by the certified March 4, 2025 results: Dryden drew 1,336 votes for the Elmore-resident seat on only 257 Elmore ballots. Shanley's 2026 re-election rests on the 2026 warning + the board page's 2029 expiry + his 2026 minutes service; no certified 2026 results sheet is posted. NOTE: the articles AOE hosts for 'Lamoille South' are the SUPERSEDED default articles of the dissolved LSUU (6 seats incl. Stowe) -- do not use them.
